name: Voolt3D (Voolt Industria e Comercio de Insumos para Manufatura Aditiva LTDA)
summary: Brazilian filament manufacturer in Sao Bernardo do Campo, Sao Paulo (CNPJ 13.210.431/0001-24), claiming the largest domestic resin-to-spool production in Brazil. Range runs from decorative PLA finishes through PETG, ABS and a small engineering group (PA6, TPU, PCTG). A US reseller storefront operates as voolt3dusa.com.

product_lines.name: Voolt PLA (Solid / Velvet / V-Silk / TriColor / Neon / Stone / Wood)
product_lines.notes: The decorative core: Velvet is the matte grade, V-Silk the luster grade, TriColor a multi-colour strand, Stone and Wood mineral- and wood-filled.

product_lines.name: Voolt ABS (incl. Metallic and Stone)
product_lines.notes: Standard ABS with pigment/filler colourways; the catalog has no stone-filled ABS id, so only the matrix id applies.

product_lines.name: Engineering (PA6, PA6-CF/graphene, TPU, PCTG)
product_lines.notes: Small technical group. The carbon/graphene-loaded nylon is listed without a stated fibre content and the graphene grade has no catalog id, so only pa6 is mapped.

additional_notes: Pricing roughly USD 18-24/kg equivalent. The 'largest domestic production' claim is the company's own. Resin-to-spool integration in Brazil is unusual - most Latin American brands import - which is the main reason Voolt3D is recorded with a confirmed manufacturing country.

provenance.conflicts: Scale claims ('largest in Brazil', full resin-to-spool integration) are self-reported. Whether the engineering grades are extruded domestically or imported was not established.
